title: Italian military band, Fazola's pranks, and the St. Bernard Country Club band
summary: Sunday Italian band rehearsals, parades, and the 1933 country club band with Tony Giardino and the Gerbright trumpet.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Yes. I think it was after Charleston. Black body and all that. Fuzz trot, waltzes and all the girls. I just wanted to get back over to the military band. It was the Italian band. It was every Sunday morning we used to go to rehearsals there. It was from about nine to twelve. Like we learned a lot. I used to have to drag Fuzzola out of bed then. And he used to make it with me. And sometime back there was a plane of March. I think it was Starling Strikes Forever. And Fuzzola was hitting some hot legs up in there. And Professor heard the thing. But he wasn't sure. So he played it back. And he hurt Fuzzola again. So he drew the baton at Fuzzola. And Fuzz started to laugh like a fool. Everybody laughed and then he got a big kick out of it. I don't know, he was something. And then on, well Thursday night we used to... I went to Tessa and Delina band. We used to make all these parades and concerts and all the parcs. Which park was that? City park. City park. Yeah. It was real nice. And about 1933 I started to play at the St. Bernard Country Club with Tony Giardino. He had his wife on up here. Her name was Lou. And then there was a drum all-man Dick Cole. Dick Cole from Oklahoma. And the trumpet man was Wilkie Gerbright. And was on sax. They had Nat Geraci. And Tony Giardino and myself. And they had Johnny Sherman on drums. That was Johnny Sherman Sr. And they had the bass man. His last name was Legnan. I don't remember his first name. Was there any kind of Roscoe like that? I think it was him. Well it's the same guy. Yeah, the same guy. And no, at the same order, the country club I tell you was selling the beer. The beer was a nickel. The wine was a nickel. And high balls were done. And Buddy used to pack them in on that. By the way, which one of those Gerbicks was that?
